exact_claim_supported: Pages should answer real user tasks/needs; same or materially similar intent keywords can be grouped and mapped to the same page.
project_specific_addition: Use the accepted current-job task/structural-unit model and phrase rows as evidence, not lexical similarity alone.
executable_action_or_output: Each Step-12 action row is traceable to a coherent user task and all of its member phrases.

exact_claim_supported: An existing page can remain the mapped owner, but a true Keep As Is content verdict normally depends on content/performance evidence.
project_specific_addition: Canonical Step-12 meaning is KEEP_STRUCTURAL_OWNER / KEEP_URL_ROLE; ranking/performance optimization is not certified when account analytics are unavailable.
executable_action_or_output: Keep current URL as structural owner without claiming that no optimization is needed.

exact_claim_supported: An existing suitable page should be enhanced when current content is independently shown to miss material needs that still belong to the same owner/task.
project_specific_addition: Expansion means only evidence-backed same-task coverage, not generic on-page optimization.
executable_action_or_output: Record explicit missing user needs from a fresh current-page read before EXPAND.

exact_claim_supported: Subordinate needs may be better answered inside an existing owner than by a standalone low-value page.
project_specific_addition: Use only when a narrow current-content deficit is proved and the task remains subordinate to the same owner.
executable_action_or_output: Add a named section/FAQ tied to explicit uncovered member needs.

exact_claim_supported: A new page is justified only when a real user need remains distinct and useful after checking current pages/reuse; more pages are not inherently better.
project_specific_addition: `NO_SUITABLE_EXISTING_PAGE` alone is insufficient; require current-site absence + reuse failure + stable distinct task + in-scope business value.
executable_action_or_output: Only then allow NEW_COMMERCIAL_PAGE or NEW_INFORMATIONAL_PAGE.

exact_claim_supported: Mapping can create a new URL where no suitable current page exists and the current job confirms a commercial/service task.
project_specific_addition: Exact action label and business boundary are KW-001 job taxonomy.
executable_action_or_output: Propose a standalone transactional/service page only after the full CREATE gate.

exact_claim_supported: A new informational URL may be planned when no suitable page exists and the need has independent user value; low-value duplicate pages should be avoided.
project_specific_addition: Exact label is project-specific; distributed existing coverage/reuse must be tested first.
executable_action_or_output: Propose standalone informational page only with a clear terminal result and implementation scope.

exact_claim_supported: Yandex does not impose a quota that requires a fixed number of useful pages.
project_specific_addition: Any delivery presentation cap is not architectural truth.
executable_action_or_output: Do not force Step-12 action/page count to a predetermined number without an explicit owner/deliverable constraint.

exact_claim_supported: Closely related same-intent variants generally do not need separate URLs merely because modifiers differ.
project_specific_addition: Price/geo/size/color/brand tokens are not independent page boundaries unless they change a stable task/object/intent.
executable_action_or_output: QA blocks CREATE based only on modifiers.

exact_claim_supported: Major logically distinct content/tasks can justify separate pages when they cannot be truthfully served as one task/page.
project_specific_addition: Exact action label and threshold are project-specific; no arbitrary numeric threshold is used.
executable_action_or_output: Split only after full member-phrase coherence and current-page evidence prove distinct major tasks.

exact_claim_supported: Duplicate/similar pages can be grouped, excluded or compete; redundant pages may be low value.
project_specific_addition: Step 12 may flag structural redundancy but does not claim harmful cannibalization without Step-13 evidence.
executable_action_or_output: Recommend structural consolidation only when one owner can truthfully cover the complete task and destructive action evidence is sufficient.

exact_claim_supported: Multiple related URLs are not automatically harmful cannibalization; a real conflict needs same/very similar search responsibility plus observed conflict/harm evidence.
project_specific_addition: KW-001 reserves actual conflict diagnosis for Step 13.
executable_action_or_output: Step 12 emits a candidate-pair handoff only; no cannibalization verdict.

exact_claim_supported: Yandex recommends clear logical sections and navigable links between related documents.
project_specific_addition: Require explicit hierarchy/placement for accepted new/split pages.
executable_action_or_output: Populate parent/section/hierarchy implementation state.

exact_claim_supported: Accepted units outside the frozen business scope must not receive first-party implementation actions without a scope change.
project_specific_addition: Exact state label is project-specific.
executable_action_or_output: Preserve outside units with explicit no-action state.

exact_claim_supported: Unresolved active phrases must remain explicit and must not be assigned a fabricated owner/action.
project_specific_addition: Exact handoff state is project-specific.
executable_action_or_output: Preserve unresolved rows with no invented structural action.

exact_claim_supported: Cluster/unit summaries can hide heterogeneous member tasks.
project_specific_addition: Carry phrase-level evidence through Step 12; later contradictory evidence reopens the materially affected member class.
executable_action_or_output: Every structural action must be inspectable against all member phrases; known-regression checks cannot substitute for global coherence.

exact_claim_supported: Transient Bridge/Codex evidence is not durable project evidence; next acquisition is blocked until save/readback.
project_specific_addition: Applies if Step 12 opens any new acquisition interaction.
executable_action_or_output: Result -> immediate GitHub write -> readback/completeness QA -> only then next acquisition.

exact_claim_supported: Current frozen upstream evidence normally supplies the task/page inputs needed for structural analysis.
project_specific_addition: Bridge is conditional, not default; no paid Search merely for reassurance.
executable_action_or_output: Use Bridge only for a named evidence gap that can materially change the Step-12 decision, with the concrete YMB gate embedded.

exact_claim_supported: Every threshold/rule must be traced; unsupported universal numeric rules are blocked.
project_specific_addition: No universal phrase-count, volume, SERP-overlap or page-count threshold is introduced in Step 12.
executable_action_or_output: Use qualitative evidence-backed decisions unless a threshold is externally/project-validated.

exact_claim_supported: A current-content/link claim must be supported by the underlying current evidence rather than by the selected action or graph edge.
project_specific_addition: D12-28/D12-29 proved that schema/action consistency can create a false PASS.
executable_action_or_output: CURRENT EVIDENCE -> OBSERVATION -> DIAGNOSIS -> ALTERNATIVES -> ACTION; verifier recomputes diagnosis without action as causal input.

exact_claim_supported: Topic/intent gaps and quality/originality gaps are different failure classes and need not imply the same URL action.
project_specific_addition: Project operational states add fail-closed `*_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT` and mixed states without attributing them to Semrush.
executable_action_or_output: Materialize STRUCTURAL_GAP_STATE separately from CONTENT_ENHANCEMENT_STATE before choosing action.

exact_claim_supported: A quality/content gap is based on what the current page fails to answer for material user needs, not on the fact that EXPAND/SECTION was selected.
project_specific_addition: D12-28 revalidation reduced 20 prior QUALITY_GAP units to 8 when current pages were actually reread.
executable_action_or_output: Require current page read, needs covered, explicit missing needs, materiality; otherwise NONE/INSUFFICIENT/other action.

exact_claim_supported: Fixing all known bad literals does not prove the remaining affected class is semantically coherent.
project_specific_addition: D12-30 showed additional mixed units outside the earlier D12-27 known set.
executable_action_or_output: When later evidence exposes a class defect, review every member in the defined affected class and independently reconcile all reassignments.

exact_claim_supported: Business/user priorities should be grounded in real business/customer evidence; public-site observations are not automatically client instructions.
project_specific_addition: Base rehearsal lacks several internal priority sources; public-site evidence must stay labelled explicit/inferred/unknown.
executable_action_or_output: Never present PUBLIC_SITE_INFERRED as CLIENT_STATED; defer policy-sensitive conclusions when material.

exact_claim_supported: Internal links should be contextually useful and lead to a destination that actually serves the user's next task.
project_specific_addition: D12-29 review retained only 15 of 28 historical IMPLEMENT rows.
executable_action_or_output: IMPLEMENT requires current source context + current target task fit + user-helpfulness; otherwise explicit DEFER/NA.

exact_claim_supported: User-visible/rendered content and crawler-accessible/search-visible textual evidence are not always equivalent.
project_specific_addition: Step 12 is not a technical SEO audit; visibility state is recorded only when it materially limits a content/structure claim.
executable_action_or_output: Use HTML_OR_SEARCH_ACCESSIBLE_CONFIRMED / RENDERED_USER_VISIBLE_ONLY / NOT_CHECKED when material.

exact_claim_supported: No fixed number of pages is required, and keyword/query evidence does not exhaust every possible customer need.
project_specific_addition: Current rehearsal may lack CRM, support, sales-call, interview and private analytics evidence.
executable_action_or_output: Report CREATE=0 only as no new URL justified by the current evidence scope, never as zero audience/topic gaps in absolute terms.

exact_claim_supported: Keep-as-is/performance decisions normally use traffic, goals and other performance evidence.
project_specific_addition: Webmaster/Metrika are unavailable in base rehearsal.
executable_action_or_output: KEEP_STRUCTURAL_OWNER does not certify performance or complete optimization.

exact_claim_supported: Current search results/competitors help reveal expected content form, angle and user-task treatment.
project_specific_addition: Step-12 structural acceptance can stand when boundary evidence is sufficient, but a later implementation brief must not invent content format/angle.
executable_action_or_output: Preserve observed SERP type/format/angle; require targeted fresh review later where implementation detail materially depends on it.

exact_claim_supported: Failed QA diagnostics are durable correction evidence and should not exist only in transient logs.
project_specific_addition: The first D12-28..30 rebuild fail exposed an invalid historical panoramic unit destination and was corrected without weakening the gate.
executable_action_or_output: Run QA -> persist diagnostics -> GitHub readback -> final acceptance gate.

exact_claim_supported: A step should not mark itself complete before the closure state is durably saved and verified.
project_specific_addition: Current job used candidate closure readback followed by completion commit and second readback.
executable_action_or_output: Persist closure candidate -> readback -> set complete -> persist final state -> final durable readback.

exact_claim_supported: Step completion requires complete phrase accounting, current evidence for material claims, independent falsification-capable QA, downstream reconciliation and durable closure readback.
project_specific_addition: Exact counters remain job-specific.
executable_action_or_output: Generate final assignments/actions/map/links/pairs/QA; fail on any blocking counter or non-repeat control; only then mark Step12 complete.
